automation.name: EOS A/B Upgrade Orchestrator
automation.description: Top-level orchestrator for an Arista EOS A/B redundant-pair upgrade: precheck, GSHUT drain + upgrade + validate Side A, operator approval gate, drain + upgrade + validate Side B, unconditional restore, per-side rollback on failure, evidence report. Task graph is a scaffold pending task wiring at Build time against the live platform's tasks.json — see docs/itential-task-map.md.

pair_id.description: Identifier for the redundant pair being upgraded

image_filename.description: Target EOS image filename in the image repository

batch_strategy.description: See spec §8 — governs cross-pair concurrency, not intra-pair A/B order
